### Fixed
- **Every `BackendTrafficPolicy` targets its route without `targetRefs[].namespace`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#377). Envoy Gateway has declared local policy target references (`group`, `kind`, `name`, `sectionName`) since v1.1, so helm-controller's server-side apply refused the four policies the connectivity chart renders with `ingress.backendTrafficPolicy.enabled` (agentgateway, muster, `kagent-controller-public`) or `kagent.uiRoute` (the kagent UI) with `.spec.targetRefs[0].namespace: field not declared in schema`, and the whole connectivity upgrade failed. A client-side apply had the API server prune the field, so the stored objects there do not change. `make verify-kagent-route` asserts it.
